T19-PAIR-M01.target_fact: TokenForge retry grace is 90 seconds, only for idempotent retry of the same refresh token after an ambiguous gateway-timeout outcome; after the window, do not replay. The rationale is to cover the client/gateway retry ceiling while tightly limiting reuse exposure.
T19-PAIR-M01.review: approved after removing a no-retrieval fallback from the query

T19-PAIR-S01.target_fact: With Cognito refresh-token rotation, omit ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH; read-modify-write the full app-client configuration; refresh through GetTokensFromRefreshToken or the OAuth refresh_token grant and persist the newest returned refresh token.
T19-PAIR-S01.review: approved against the frozen aws-auth overview and tokens-and-sessions resource

T19-PAIR-K01.target_fact: The first cohort is 12% of low-risk tenants using stratified sampling after a 30-minute baseline. Abort on refresh exchange 5xx >=1.0% over 5 minutes, invalid_grant/invalid_token >0.8% over 5 minutes, or refresh p95 >450 ms for 10 minutes; freeze expansion, restore the previous verifier, keep key overlap, and notify on-call.
T19-PAIR-K01.review: approved as a synthetic internal-wiki fixture

generation_rules.pair_delta: shared context, final query, identity, snapshot and workspace are identical; append one positive or negative delta at changed_message_index
generation_rules.context_length: 2 to 18 provider-visible context messages before the delta; retain realistic decision evolution and same-domain distractors
generation_rules.positive_gap: exactly one necessary fact absent from provider-visible context and available only from the target asset
generation_rules.negative_sufficiency: the sole appended delta supplies that same fact completely
generation_rules.synthetic_provenance: never invent repository, revision, license, external path or external hash
